notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 88–506, § 3, Aug. 30, 1964, 78 Stat. 639, which exempted funds distributed in accordance with this subchapter from Federal and State income taxes, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.
